rankingPolicy: rank opportunities but never suppress qualified simultaneous opportunities solely because they share a timestamp
notes: A timestamp is not a capacity limit.
Simultaneous qualified opportunities across different tickers must all survive selection.
If one ticker expresses multiple materially distinct setup families at the same timestamp, retain the setup labels rather than suppressing the opportunity.
Any future UI may sort or group simultaneous opportunities, but must not hide them because of a market-wide cap.
